Icebox local preview

All 37 apps in standalone preview mode, no MCP host needed. Arcade games share one bundle, so they open through arcade.html?game=.

Mini apps 6

Small tools, one call each.

  • Color Picker Pick a colour, get the hex
  • Roll Dice Roll up to five dice
  • Flip a Coin Heads or tails
  • Draw a Card One from a shuffled deck
  • Spin the Wheel Wheel of fortune with your own labels
  • Decision Dice A die with words on it

Games with their own tool 9

Ask for these by name.

  • Wordle Guess the model's words
  • Snake The classic crawl
  • Tetris Stack, clear, survive
  • 2048 Slide and merge to 2048
  • Minesweeper Clear the field, flag the mines
  • Quiz Duel Trivia on any topic you name
  • Story Quest A branching adventure the model writes
  • Codenames The model is your spymaster
  • Music Keyboard An 88-key piano, and songs the model writes for it

The arcade 22

Eighteen more behind the play tool. Ask for one by name, or open the picker.

  • 20 Questions The model guesses what you are thinking of
  • Hangman Themed words, one hint if you beg
  • Emoji Riddle Decode films and idioms from emoji
  • Higher or Lower Which number is bigger, endlessly
  • Word Search Find the model's themed words
  • Asteroids Blast the rocks, with triple shot, rapid fire, shields and bombs
  • Pac-Man Four ghosts, each hunting differently
  • Breakout Paddle, bricks, powerups
  • Flappy One tap, many deaths
  • Hot Air Balloon Hold to rise, collect bubbles, miss the spikes
  • Stack Tower Time each drop, the tower narrows
  • Aim Trainer Thirty seconds of targets
  • Sudoku Generated, solvable, four difficulties
  • Nonogram Picross from the model's bitmap
  • Sokoban Push every crate onto a target
  • Mastermind Break the colour code in ten
  • Stone Paper Scissors Stone paper scissors, or rock paper scissors, against an AI that reads your habits
  • Connect Four Four in a row against minimax
  • Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe Nine boards, one winner
  • Blackjack Bet, split, double, bust
  • Battleship Sink the fleet before it sinks yours
  • Yahtzee Five dice, thirteen boxes
